fusions.name: Hamstring Run
fusions.desc: Rats hack at ankles in a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 7 damage to everything in it and leaving each target [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Timberfall
fusions.desc: A heavy chop at an enemy up to 3 tiles away that deals 30 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach, then rats burst from the wound and bite every enemy within 3 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Honed on the Handle
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Chips Fly
fusions.desc: Each time you land a critical hit, a rat bites the nearest enemy within 6 tiles for 6 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
